items.title: Signal will block AI assistants from reading its chats
items.summary: On iOS 27 and Android, Signal will block screen capture when it detects an assistant reading the screen, as it did for Microsoft Recall.

items.title: State AGs fight Character.AI's plan to sell users' private chats
items.summary: The bankruptcy auction covers chats from more than 21 million U.S. accounts, 2.1 million of them registered to minors.

items.title: OpenAI merges Chat and Work under one usage meter

items.title: Anthropic's 2028 power will come 87% from gas and 11% from coal
items.summary: A case study of its contracted U.S. data centers puts 2028 emissions near 32 million tonnes of CO2 in the mid case.

items.title: Anthropic breaks below its $83 IPO price

items.title: Nvidia pauses server shipments to Southeast Asia

items.title: The New York Times tells photographers not to update Photoshop
items.summary: Photoshop 2027's AI features can mark photos as AI-edited in their C2PA metadata, even after minimal edits.
